subLocations.name: the lady dreaming
subLocations.lore:
History
During the Spellplague of 1385 DR, the walking statue appeared and rampaged through the city. When the statues were stopped, she fell onto her side, where she still lay by 1492 DR.[

Description
It resembled a noble woman asleep in a garden. She bore the appearance of a female elf and, while active, her clothing and hair appeared to move naturally

subLocations.name: gralkyn's tavern
subLocations.lore:
History
During the Spellplague of 1385 DR, the walking statue appeared and rampaged through the city. When stopped, the statue tumbled backwards onto a building.

Gralkyn's Tavern sat in the statue's lap by 1492 

Description
The pose resembled that of a drunkard who had fallen asleep, its arms limp to the sides and its head tilted on its chest. The statue originally carried a large stone battleaxe, which was located nearby in the cobbles where it fell.

lore: The City of Splendors, a massive metropolis on the Sword Coast.
name: Waterdeep

Tavern.name: Durnan
Tavern.portraitDescription: A rugged, middle-aged human with a scarred face and a quiet, watchful demeanor. He wears practical leather armor under his apron.

visualTraits.distinguishingFeatures: A deep scar across his cheek

Arcane Shop.name: Laeral Silverhand
Arcane Shop.portraitDescription: An ethereal High Elf with silver hair that glows faintly. She wears ornate, flowing robes of deep blue and silver.

visualTraits.distinguishingFeatures: Eyes that shimmer with arcane power

Weaponsmith.name: Thrak Hammerfist
Weaponsmith.portraitDescription: A stout Mountain Dwarf with a soot-stained beard braided with iron rings. His arms are thick with muscle.

General Store.name: Mirt
General Store.portraitDescription: A portly, jovial human with a large mustache and twinkling eyes. He wears expensive but worn traveler's silks.

visualTraits.distinguishingFeatures: A booming laugh and twinkling eyes

General Store.name: Obaya Uday
General Store.portraitDescription: A tall, grey-skinned Goliath with lithic patterns on her skin. She wears simple vestments and carries a heavy staff.

Thieves Guild.name: Jarlaxle Baenre
Thieves Guild.portraitDescription: A slender Drow with a flamboyant purple hat featuring a large feather. He wears an eye patch and a colorful cloak.

visualTraits.distinguishingFeatures: Purple hat with a giant feather
